name: Content Repurposing Planner
description: Paste your YouTube video or podcast and get a full repurposing plan: which clips to extract, where to post them, and why.
seoTitle: AI Content Repurposing Planner for Creators
seoDescription: Paste your YouTube video or podcast and get a full repurposing plan: which clips to extract, where to post them, and exactly how to maximize reach.
long_description:
The biggest waste in content isn't a bad video. It's a good video that lives on one platform for one week and then dies.

This skill analyzes your long-form content and builds a repurposing roadmap across 5–10 formats. It identifies the highest-value moments, matches them to the right platforms, and outputs ready-to-use briefs so you can start executing immediately.

What you get:
- Repurposing roadmap: which clips, quotes, and moments to extract
- Platform matching: Twitter (punchy, opinionated), LinkedIn (professional, insight-focused), Instagram (visual, emotional), TikTok (fast, hook-first)
- Content briefs with format notes, caption framing, and hashtag strategy
- Priority ranking: which pieces will drive the most reach vs. quick wins

Free to try. For the skill that actually writes the repurposed content (not just the plan), see Video-to-Everything Repurposer.

Perfect for creators who know they should repurpose but freeze up deciding what goes where.
author: CreatorSkills
